test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the bracketed segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'no substitution required'.**

(Neither of the political factions have had much) interest in environmental intent.

options.text: Neither of the political factions have had any
Neither of the political faction has have much
Neither of the political factions has had much

solution:
The correct answer is** "Neither of the political factions has had much."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Neither"** is usually used with a singular verb.

 
 
• **Example**: *"Neither one **is**__ here."*
 
 
 
• **"Has"** is the correct singular form of the verb **"have."**
 
• **"Much"** is the correct word to use in this context.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

**Correct sentence**: *__**Ne__**ither of the political factions has had much interest in environmental intent. *
